info.title: Agentry API
info.description: Generated by scripts/gen_api_docs.py. See docs/API_BACKEND.md for conventions.

post.summary: Create a workspace and its owner (or join a workspace with an invite).
post.description:
Returns: `{ok: true}` and a session cookie. New workspaces get four starter agents.

Minimum role: public.

200.description: `{ok: true}` and a session cookie. New workspaces get four starter agents.

400.description: invalid email/short password, or invalid/used invite

name.description: Display name (defaults to the part of the email before @)

workspace.description: Business name for the new workspace (ignored with an invite)

invite_token.description: Token from an invite link; joins that workspace with the invited role

post.summary: Sign in. Sets the session cookie.
post.description:
Returns: `{ok: true}` and a session cookie. Call `GET /api/me` next for the CSRF token.

Minimum role: public.

200.description: `{ok: true}` and a session cookie. Call `GET /api/me` next for the CSRF token.

post.summary: Sign out (clears the session).
post.description:
Returns: `{ok: true}`

Minimum role: public.

post.summary: Change your own password.
post.description:
Returns: `{ok: true}`

Minimum role: any signed-in.

get.summary: Who is signed in, their workspace, and the CSRF token for write requests.
get.description:
Returns: `user` {id, workspace_id, email, name, role}, `workspace` {id, name}, `csrf` (send as `X-CSRF-Token`), `setup` {model_ready: false while replies come from the placeholder model, real_whatsapp: false until a real (non-sandbox) number exists, test_tools: whether Sandbox/Simulate are enabled} (drives the sidebar's Finish setup card).

Minimum role: any signed-in.

200.description: `user` {id, workspace_id, email, name, role}, `workspace` {id, name}, `csrf` (send as `X-CSRF-Token`), `setup` {model_ready: false while replies come from the placeholder model, real_whatsapp: false until a real (non-sandbox) number exists, test_tools: whether Sandbox/Simulate are enabled} (drives the sidebar's Finish setup card).

get.summary: Your recent Playground chats (max 30, newest first).
get.description:
Returns: `sessions[]` {id, title, agent_id, updated_at}

Minimum role: supervisor.

sessions.title: What is the return policy for sale items?

post.summary: Start a new Playground chat.
post.description:
Returns: `{id}` of the new session (201).

Minimum role: supervisor.

agent_id.description: Agent to talk to (can change per message)

get.summary: One Playground chat with all its messages.
get.description:
Returns: `session` and `messages[]` {id, role: user|assistant, text, sources[{file, locator}], meta{model, agent}, created_at}

Minimum role: supervisor.

200.description: `session` and `messages[]` {id, role: user|assistant, text, sources[{file, locator}], meta{model, agent}, created_at}

messages.text: What is the return policy for sale items?
Sale items can be returned within 14 days for store credit.

session.title: What is the return policy for sale items?

post.summary: Send a message to the agent and get its answer (synchronous; waits for the model). With no AI model set up it answers 502 with "No AI model is set up yet…".
post.description:
Returns: `{id, role: "assistant", text, sources[{file, locator}], meta{model, agent}}`. `meta.model` is "Platform default" when the hidden model answered.

Minimum role: supervisor.

200.description: `{id, role: "assistant", text, sources[{file, locator}], meta{model, agent}}`. `meta.model` is "Platform default" when the hidden model answered.

example.text: Sale items can be returned within 14 days for store credit.

502.description: every configured model failed (message lists why)

use_knowledge.description: Search the agent's knowledge files (default true)

example.text: What is the return policy for sale items?

get.summary: All agents in the workspace, plus available templates.
get.description:
Returns: `agents[]` {id, name, description, color, instructions, model_override{provider, model}|null, active, file_count, chat_count, active_model}, `templates[]` (names)

Minimum role: viewer.

200.description: `agents[]` {id, name, description, color, instructions, model_override{provider, model}|null, active, file_count, chat_count, active_model}, `templates[]` (names)

agents.instructions: You are the customer service agent for {business}. Be warm and brief — two or three sentences. Only answer from the knowledge sources. If…
agents.name: Customer Service

agents.instructions: You coordinate projects for {business}. Confirm dates, owners and next steps clearly. Never promise a date that is not in the sources.
agents.name: Project Manager

post.summary: Create an agent (optionally from a template).
post.description:
Returns: `{id}` (201)

Minimum role: admin.

name.description: Unique in the workspace (or give `template` and it's used as the name)

instructions.description: System prompt; `{business}` becomes the workspace name

model_override.description: `{provider, model}` to use a specific model, or null

example.name: Receptionist
example.instructions: Greet customers of {business} and share opening hours.

patch.summary: Update an agent. Send only the fields to change.

model_override.description: `{provider, model}` or null to use the workspace model

example.instructions: You are the customer service agent for {business}. Be brief.

delete.summary: Delete an agent. Its chats become unassigned.

get.summary: All knowledge sources with indexing status.
get.description:
Returns: `files[]` {id, filename, kind, source_url, size_bytes, status: pending|indexing|ready|failed, error, chunk_count, agents[{id,name}], created_at, updated_at}, `total_chunks`

Minimum role: viewer.

200.description: `files[]` {id, filename, kind, source_url, size_bytes, status: pending|indexing|ready|failed, error, chunk_count, agents[{id,name}], created_at, updated_at}, `total_chunks`

post.summary: Upload one or more files. Indexing runs in the background: poll the list until `status` is `ready`.
post.description:
Returns: `{created: [file ids], errors: [{file, error}]}`: 201 if at least one file was accepted

Minimum role: supervisor.

201.description: `{created: [file ids], errors: [{file, error}]}`: 201 if at least one file was accepted

400.description: no files, or every file unsupported

files.description: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT or MD (max `MAX_UPLOAD_MB` each request)

agent_ids.description: Agents allowed to use these files (repeat the field)

post.summary: Add pasted text / Q&A as a knowledge source.
post.description:
Returns: `{id}` (201)

Minimum role: supervisor.

title.description: Shown in the file list (default "Quick Q&A")

example.title: Returns FAQ
example.text: Sale items can be returned within 14 days for store credit.

post.summary: Add one public web page. It's fetched in the background (private/internal addresses are refused).
post.description:
Returns: `{id}` (201). If the fetch fails the file shows `status: failed` with the reason.

Minimum role: supervisor.

201.description: `{id}` (201). If the fetch fails the file shows `status: failed` with the reason.

patch.summary: Change which agents may use a file.

agent_ids.description: Full new list (replaces the old one)

delete.summary: Delete a file, its chunks and agent links.

post.summary: Extract and index the file again.
post.description:
Returns: `{ok: true}`; status goes back to `pending`

Minimum role: supervisor.

get.summary: All connected numbers (no secrets).
get.description:
Returns: `connections[]` {id, name, provider, phone_number, account_name, profile_picture, status: pending|connected|disconnected|expired|error, status_detail, default_agent_id, default_mode, webhook_url, last_event_at, last_message_at, created_at}

Minimum role: viewer.

200.description: `connections[]` {id, name, provider, phone_number, account_name, profile_picture, status: pending|connected|disconnected|expired|error, status_detail, default_agent_id, default_mode, webhook_url, last_event_at, last_message_at, created_at}

post.summary: Add a number. For Evolution API this also creates the instance, registers our webhook and returns the first QR code.
post.description:
Returns: `connection` (201). Evolution adds `qr` (data URL) and `pairing_code` when the server answered; if it didn't, `status` is `error` with the reason in `status_detail`.

Minimum role: admin.

201.description: `connection` (201). Evolution adds `qr` (data URL) and `pairing_code` when the server answered; if it didn't, `status` is `error` with the reason in `status_detail`.

400.description: unknown provider or missing config keys

config.description: Credentials (stored encrypted). evolution: `{server_url, api_key}` · meta_cloud: `{phone_number_id, access_token, app_secret, verify_token}` · generic: `{send_url, token?}` · sandbox: `{}`

patch.summary: Rename a number or set its defaults for new chats.

default_agent_id.description: Agent for new chats on this number (null = workspace default)

delete.summary: Remove a number and all its chats. For Evolution it also logs the phone out and deletes the instance on the Evolution server (best effort).

get.summary: Current QR code to link an Evolution number.
get.description:
Returns: `{qr: "data:image/png;base64,…" | null, pairing_code}`; `qr` is null when already linked

Minimum role: admin.

200.description: `{qr: "data:image/png;base64,…" | null, pairing_code}`; `qr` is null when already linked

post.summary: Ask the provider for the live status and store it.
post.description:
Returns: `connection` with updated `status`

Minimum role: viewer.

post.summary: **Test tools only** (`ENABLE_TEST_TOOLS=true`; answers 404 otherwise). Inject a customer message as if it came from WhatsApp. Runs the full reply pipeline (testing without a phone).
post.description:
Returns: `{message_id}` (201); null if ignored (e.g. duplicate).

Minimum role: admin.

patch.summary: Update general settings. Send only what changes.
patch.description:
Returns: The full general settings after saving

Minimum role: admin.

200.description: The full general settings after saving

delete.summary: Permanently delete the workspace and everything in it.

get.summary: Model settings and which providers have keys.
get.description:
Returns: `settings` (see PATCH), `providers[]` {id, label, connected, last4, base_url, verified_at}, `active_model` ("Platform default" or "provider · model"). Keys are never returned.

Minimum role: viewer.

200.description: `settings` (see PATCH), `providers[]` {id, label, connected, last4, base_url, verified_at}, `active_model` ("Platform default" or "provider · model"). Keys are never returned.

patch.description:
Returns: `settings` after saving

Minimum role: admin.

model.description: Model id at that provider, e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`

fallback.description: Fall back to the platform default when the workspace key fails

put.summary: Save (or replace) an API key for a provider. Stored encrypted.
put.description:
Returns: `{ok: true, switched}`. If the workspace had no real model yet, it is switched to this key automatically (source `byok`, a starter model such as `gpt-4o-mini`, or the first model the key lists if that one isn't available) and the response includes `switched: true` and the new `settings`.

Minimum role: admin.

200.description: `{ok: true, switched}`. If the workspace had no real model yet, it is switched to this key automatically (source `byok`, a starter model such as `gpt-4o-mini`, or the first model the key lists if that one isn't available) and the response includes `switched: true` and the new `settings`.

api_key.description: Required the first time; blank keeps the stored key

base_url.description: Proxy / Azure / self-hosted endpoint (required for openai_compatible)

get.summary: Models the saved key can use (for the model pickers). Cached for 10 minutes.
get.description:
Returns: `{models: [ids]}`

Minimum role: admin.

502.description: no key saved, or the provider rejected it (message included)

post.summary: Check the saved key by listing the provider's models.
post.description:
Returns: `{ok: true, models: [ids]}`; also marks the key verified. If this provider is the workspace model and no model name is set, the first listed model is selected and returned as `model_selected`.

Minimum role: admin.

200.description: `{ok: true, models: [ids]}`; also marks the key verified. If this provider is the workspace model and no model name is set, the first listed model is selected and returned as `model_selected`.

502.description: no key saved, or the provider rejected it (message included)
